stage_rules.new: First seen: fewer than 2 Google observations and no second source family
stage_rules.building: Repeated observations, or a second source family (Wikipedia reads, the fixture calendar)
stage_rules.rising: Newest comparable observation ≥ +5 heat on the previous, base ≥ 1,000 searches
stage_rules.sustained: ≥ 3 comparable observations over ≥ 6 h, newest within ±5 heat
stage_rules.cooling: Newest comparable observation ≤ −5 heat on the previous, or off the newest sweep

expiry_rule: A verdict expires when its newest supporting observation is older than the limit: search 3 h (30 min for a row about a big match in its live window), reading 3 days. An expired Promote now / Promote becomes Re-check, with the age shown.
